evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued as a command to the audience, enacting hierarchy through direct instruction.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Second-person imperative commanding erasure of knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what the audience must and must not hold.
Assertive overwriting of a prior record from a position of authority — declaring the institutional fact that supersedes what was previously known.
